certification.name: IBM and ISC2 Cybersecurity Specialist Professional Certificate
certification.description: Twelve-course entry-level program from IBM and ISC2 covering security principles, access controls, network security, security operations and incident response, with preparation for the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity exam. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 3 months at 10 hours a week.
